context: Vlaakith appears as a hologram through a planecaster in the Creche and orders that a prisoner (the artefact‑linked prisoner, often Orpheus) be killed; Laezel and the player are present for the encounter. The player/avatar can either accept or refuse Vlaakith’s command — the planecaster activates in either case. If you refuse, Vlaakith instructs the inquisitor (if still alive) to kill you should you try to leave, or threatens to hunt you down if the inquisitor is already dead. Orphan Laezel automatically accepts Vlaakith’s orders, while a non‑committed Laezel can still be swayed by the player during this confrontation; Vlaakith also tempts Laezel with promises of ascension to secure her obedience.
